rationale: Ahmad is building AI-native hardware at Midjourney with deep expertise in spatial computing and hand-tracking from Apple Vision Pro and Leap Motion, while Manolo is architecting production-grade voice as core infrastructure at ai-coustics. As Ahmad explores novel AI hardware form factors that integrate deeply with generative AI models rather than bolt-on features, Manolo's conviction on audio reliability and studio-quality preprocessing could inform how voice becomes a natural interaction layer in next-gen hardware interfaces—especially when users are multitasking.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Manolo Espinosa — you're both in San Francisco building production-ready AI interfaces (hardware and voice respectively) and could explore how voice preprocessing fits into AI-native form factors beyond wearables.
